title: String of paper lanterns, lit
section: Second round: Acts I and II
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Production sprite for Widow's Bay.
Exactly the same swagged string of eight round paper lanterns as lantern-string, with the same framing and lantern positions, every lantern glowing warm from inside (the game lights them one by one by showing parts of this image over the unlit string). Flat painted toy-theatre cut-out seen square-on, gouache on card with a faint pale cut edge; early-1900s stencil-tinted colour: sepia-grey line and tone with translucent washes of plum #2a1424, rose pink #f3c6dc, magenta #e0127a, moon gold #d9b34a, coral red #c8321e and grotto teal #5f8c88 laid slightly out of register; no cast shadow; no lettering; isolated on a transparent background (or flat pure magenta #FF00FF if transparency is unavailable).
Requested final aspect ratio 1200:300. Real transparent alpha outside the isolated art.
Input image is a style/palette reference; follow the written subject and geometry rather than reproducing unwanted elements.
No text or watermark. This is a precise edit of the supplied image: preserve outline, framing, all positions and ornament. Change only the light/colour/symbol requested.
